dct_title_s: S.W. prospect of William's Fort at Whidah
dct_description_sm: Leaf comprising two prospects, a bird's eye view and a floor plan, all showing Whidah or Grand Popo.
Includes three additional drawings:  1. Great Popo, or Torri Bay from Barbot (left) 2. Several sorts of Fetissos from Barbot (middle) 3. Plan of William's Fort (right)
